fields.description: Infinity is a waterfront villa collection on Ramhan Island in Abu Dhabi. The homes sit within an island masterplan of bays, mangroves and marina destinations, with private outdoor space connecting the villas to their shoreline setting.

overview: Infinity is a distinct villa release within Ramhan Island; the island-wide marina and hospitality destinations are separate planned facilities.
